name: phase-diagnostic
analysis: scripts/phase_diagnostic.py --analyze: per lineup and phase, analyze_search_diagnostic.analyze over all legal options (split-half reliability; unbiased headroom of perfect choice vs the served move, game-clustered bootstrap 95% CI; best-option types).
decision_rule: A phase shows 'real headroom' if its 'first' headroom is >= +0.02 per decision with the CI lower bound > 0 in at least one lineup. Real headroom => aim the next search/planning work at that phase; otherwise record that the remaining strength is spread thinly. Bar fixed before any game.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-06 (Jerry: 'Yes' to running the oracle diagnostic on opening placement and robber, after search-diagnostic-v1 showed <1pp per build/trade decision). Seat 0 = planner_pv2_b_fix (delegates these phases to the served bot). Setup uses 32 playouts (about 50 options) and one of seat 0's two placements per game (alternating by seed parity) to fit ~2.5 h on ultra.
